about: Inkling 2 Mini oQ4e with M1 Max Metal kernels (--m1-fast --affine4), fixed DSpark depth 6, 65,536 tokens per sequence, and two request slots on Metal. Text validated at concurrency one.
install: Download https://github.com/jundot/omlx/releases/download/v0.8.2/oMLX-0.8.2-macos26-27.dmg (SHA-256 6316ad32cde3248bcf23abece8b9222847f7ae8e594cea1b378a34049252df78) and copy its oMLX.app under runtime/ in the recipe directory. Clone https://github.com/nerveband/inkling-m1max-lab at commit c27638e05ed80d76598868e87fb0d7656def6e86 into inkling-m1max-lab/ and install Python 3.12.
